description: a snapshot entry written under another format or canonicalization is a typed unusable outcome, never misread: a state holding a real format-1 entry (the per-entry-document shape an earlier build wrote, committed byte for byte) and the bytes of a real current entry with only its header's canonicalization changed (3) lists no intact entry, reports each as KDLITH-CAC002 naming the header it was written under beside this version's (format=2 canonicalization=2), exits 1, and leaves both files byte-identical
